periods.label: Week of August 3, 2026
periods.summary: This week focused heavily on refining the visual and functional aspects of spells and character interaction. We clarified spell ownership colors by tinting enemy spell effects, projectiles, and attack areas red, recoloring hero blood spells purple, and introducing a distinct non-Healing effect for Rapid Regeneration. Features included adding two-handed weapon classes and rework visuals for lights and skills, alongside various balancing changes such as capping multi-hit spell proc chance and adjusting mana costs; the minimum level requirement for spells was removed while increasing their cost. New features introduced included a new spell called Blizzard and reworked the Boomrang spell and Rage mechanisms, along with implementing a reroll mechanism and stat UI fixes. The spell system received numerous refinements: filtering button logic, placing spell activation costs and proc behavior into computed tooltips, replacing catalog dropdowns with additive checkbox buttons, and adding a new badge for learning spells. Visual improvements included adding shadows and improving light for certain spells, setting default lights to all, and fixing rendering issues like throw and visual/spell fixes. Furthermore, the HUD was updated by grouping hero effects above health, and spell HUDs were fixed. Finally, work focused on ensuring items equipped with spells correctly add passive mechanics and that thorns from spells are displayed in the HUD.

ux(realm): reorganize the presence header
commits.description:
Place Options and Leave to Lobby at the extreme left, followed immediately by the concise wave status, while removing guard, attacker, and queue noise from the realm controls.

Center a combined online and realm-presence summary that reports solo waiting or lists unique clickable opponents in red alongside an italicized current player label.

commits.title: ux(panels): remove character and inventory tilt
commits.description:
Replace the perspective and rotateY entry treatment with flat side-specific slide-and-fade animations, settling both panels at translateX(0).

Retain will-change for transform and opacity on both containers so transitions remain smoothly composited.

commits.title: ux(auth): type login feedback by result
commits.description:
Extend server notices with an explicit success or error tone and advance protocol compatibility to version 41.

Render Joining arena as green success feedback in the authentication modal while rejected passwords and invalid login responses retain the red error treatment.

commits.title: fix(auth): show password errors inside the modal
commits.description:
Add an assertive authentication notice within the password dialog and route feedback there while the dialog is open, keeping incorrect-password errors visible instead of rendering them behind the modal.

Clear modal feedback whenever authentication opens or is cancelled.

commits.title: fix(auth): persist and present existing passwords correctly
commits.description:
Apply newly created hashes before dirty snapshotting and flush them before the socket accepts another command, ensuring later username login verifies the established password.

Hide password confirmation with an explicit hidden-state rule for existing accounts, leaving two fields only in password-creation mode.

Move Devlog exclusively into the shared header outside realm states, unify rounded shadow-based header controls, and advance protocol compatibility to version 40.

commits.title: ux(login): dock the top-player list on the left
commits.description:
Separate the leaderboard from the bottom-centered login form and vertically center it along the left edge in a scrollable panel capped at 90 percent of viewport height.

Limit leaderboard payloads to the top 100 ranked heroes while carrying a separate total online count so header presence remains accurate beyond the displayed list.

commits.title: feat(auth): secure username login and shared presence header
commits.description:
Keep the game header visible before login with Devlog, Options, and a live online-player count, and bottom-center the login panel.

Challenge new and legacy passwordless accounts to create an 8-128 character password, verify existing account passwords, and persist only Bun-generated password hashes through a backwards-compatible nullable SQL column.

Extend protocol, HUD, persistence, and focused regression coverage for authentication requirements, password validation, hash round-tripping, and protocol version 39.
